ios.desc:
Your all-in-one road trip planner, route planner, and shared travel companion.

Outpost Go is the smarter way to plan, organize, share, and enjoy every trip. Build complete travel itineraries with drives, flights, hotels, scenic stops, restaurants, activities, and everything in between—all in one place.

Whether you are planning a weekend getaway, a cross-country road trip, a family vacation, or a multi-city adventure with friends, Outpost Go keeps your route, schedule, stops, packing, and travel group organized from the first idea to the final destination.

Plan together, edit together, and stay on the same page throughout the entire journey.

With Outpost Go, you can:

PLAN YOUR COMPLETE TRIP

Create a clear day-by-day travel itinerary with drives, flights, hotel stays, activities, food breaks, and custom stops. See where you are going, how you are getting there, and what comes next.

DROP PINS AND DISCOVER NEARBY PLACES

Long-press anywhere on the map to drop a pin, save a place, or add it directly to a day in your trip.

Explore useful places near your location or route, including:

• Restrooms
• Gas stations
• EV charging stations
• Cafés and restaurants
• Hotels and lodging
• Scenic viewpoints
• Attractions and activities

Quickly turn places you discover on the map into organized trip stops.

FIND STOPS ALONG YOUR ROUTE

Search for useful places without losing track of your journey. Find food, fuel, restrooms, EV chargers, scenic stops, and other destinations near your route, then see how each stop fits into your trip.

BUILD SMARTER ROAD TRIP ROUTES

Organize your trip by day, stop order, drive time, distance, and travel type. Keep every destination in the right place so even complex road trips feel simple and manageable.

COMPARE GAS STATION PRICES

View nearby gas stations and compare fuel prices when available, helping you choose smarter and more convenient stops while traveling.

PLAN AND COLLABORATE TOGETHER

Share trips with friends or family, keep plans synced, and let your travel group follow the same route, stops, schedule, and updates.

Everyone can stay connected without relying on scattered group chats, screenshots, or separate travel apps.

ASK SCOUT FOR TRAVEL IDEAS

Use Scout, your AI travel assistant, to discover restaurants, scenic views, activities, hotels, lake stops, attractions, and ideas near your route.

Scout helps turn a rough trip idea into a more organized adventure while keeping you in control of every decision.

FOLLOW

quotes.text:
Hi Hacker News,

Im really happy to announce a major update Outpost Go 1.4.0!

This new update has a lot of features I thought were necessary for planning the perfect road trip like trip-cost planning, weather, route-aware stops, and car/RV lodging options!

I would love if anyone here could try it and let me know what works, what doesn’t, or what you think is still missing.

Thanks!
